READ_THIS_FIRST: INTENTIONAL NEGATIVE CONTROLS - THESE ARE NOT BUGS. Every entry here is built to produce a fail or miss on purpose, and each declares the grade it must produce via its "expect" field. replay.js passes an entry when its actual grade EQUALS its "expect", so a green run means the grading rules still reject what they should. If an entry here starts reporting BROKEN, the bug is in src/grade.js having become too permissive (or too strict) - do NOT "fix" it by editing the expected/camera/click data to make it pass.
provenance: Hand-assembled from fixtures/self-test.json - the only fixture in this repo that is written rather than recorded. The camera and clickScreen values are real recorded data lifted from the entries named in each note; only the "expected" block is altered, so the raycast itself stays genuine.
